alignment_target: vLLM 0.29.0 deepep_high_throughput; Qwen3-30B-A3B BF16 TP2 DP2 EP4

lineage.reason: Same RouterOutput IDs/FP32 weights. Preserve the Runner-owned native Gate: Qwen 0.29 passes hidden_states as the router_logits placeholder. No duplicate-Gate elimination is claimed.
Same uniform placement; align public names, preserve -1 padding behavior.

Keep familiar payload fields and record identities. Direct stable Rank packing composes the source permutations; Expert-major sorting remains on the receiver, preserving each Expert order while avoiding an extra source copy.
Same NCCL row splits; align public names. Keep TP reassembly in integration, remove only owner compatibility reduction.
Keep six explicit phases. Framework owns weights/router, so a stateless tensor interface is necessary; pack routing weights with rows.
Same stable prefix and inverse record identities. Rank key/fixed capacity avoid host reads for short decode.
Align organization. Preserve device planning, tuned tiles, SwiGLU rounding and tl.dot(a,b,acc), which differs from summing separately rounded block products. FP32 weight precedes output cast.
Same inverse index/slot loop. DeepEP requires FP32 owner-local sum, model-dtype owner rounding, then owner-rank FP32 merge; branch weights are already applied.
Keep common NVTX stages and optional CUDA-event boundary timing, outside precision probes.
Preserve synchronous A2A/layout contracts. No new stream/chunk route or unmeasured overlap claim is required.
Keep offsets/tile_experts/tile_rows/block_m; remove Host counts from production plan, keep known num_rows; independent Host plan stays outside mini_ep.

runtime_compatibility.changes: Two wrapper docstrings corrected after numerical freeze; no executable Mini-EP changes.
